Hero_Desc_Daya:
Noble and skilled top Dragon.
She enjoys dressing up and being well-groomed. But maybe she takes it too far with that?
Daya's excessive naivety makes it challenging for the denizens to approach her initially.
Album_Hate_Daya: Fragile minerals. Fake diamonds turned out to be made of glass.
Album_Daya1: The strongest among the dragons, it is said she was born from diamonds. No physical force or magic seems to affect Daya, but that might just be a rumor.
Album_Daya2: Daya dislikes only staying in dark, underground caves, claiming one looks the most beautiful under the light. That's why Daya sometimes sneaks up to the surface to bask in the sunlight.
Album_Daya3: Daya is obsessed with styling and taking care of herself. Despite her snobby appearance, Daya is incredibly hardworking, often saying, "An uncut diamond is just coal."
Album_Daya4: Becoming the chief of the Dragons wasn't Daya's choosing. It was just that the other dragons naturally respected her, being the one who shined the brightest.
Album_Daya5: Daya seems to unknowingly be the model for elf cosmetic ads. Upon a Daya sighting, the elves often whisper in surprise. Daya doesn't even know what an advertisement is.
Album_Daya6: I've had a chance to see Daya's treasure trove. It was a dazzling room filled with diamonds. Interestingly, there was a pile of glass windows, from who knows where, in one corner of the room. She may be born from diamonds, but I think the ability to distinguish them... might be another matter.
Album_Daya7: Daya dreams of one day displaying the twinkling starlight from the sky in her personal warehouse. I tried explaining what starlight really was, but... I figured it wouldn't hurt to just let her dream.
LoveHero_Daya:
Receiving attention is quite a
different feeling.
LoveHeroCancel_Daya:
You wanna be
alone?
I guess it can't be helped.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Hate1: Daya was displeased, claiming she was given a bunch of defective gemstones.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Hate2:
After biting into the unopened canned chow, Daya spat it out, saying it tasted weird. 
Someone should teach her the concept of packaging.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like1:
Daya doesn't look like she believes this dish is topped with the shiniest of gems. 
I caught her secretly selecting a few and pocketing them.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like2: After trying the lemon tea, Daya said it would be perfect for her tea party, taking a few more drinks to-go.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like3: Daya seemed satisfied with its appearance, saying it resembled finely ground gemstone powder, as well as its taste.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like4: They initially struggled with the soft texture but once they got used to it, they were the only thing the Apostles looked for.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like5: Initially she was indifferent, saying it's similar to gold dust. But later she found it interesting because, unlike gold, it has a sour taste.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like6: Daya said the food seemed made with care, expressing concern for me while also finding it tasty.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like7: Daya hesitantly asked if there was anything more solid. After taking a bite, she said the warmth in the cave is much appreciated.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like8: Daya mentioned that she's seen elves promoting Almond Pralines and using her as a model. She also mentioned that it suits her as well as cosmetics do.
Food_ChefNote_Daya_Like9: Daya said it's a candy of tremendous quality, as if made by a famous chef.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Daya: Nothing is harder than a diamond!
Gacha_Result_Line1_Daya: The strongest of the dragons has arrived.
Daya_Spawn: Nothing is tougher than a diamond!
Daya_Spawn1: Nothing is tougher than a diamond!
Daya_Growth1: Thou art getting closer to perfection.
Daya_Victory2: This is the result of relentless effort.
Daya_Defeat2: I must put forth a bit more effort.
Daya_Affinity1_1: Touching leaves marks, look with thine eyes.
Daya_Affinity2: Continuous self-care alone makes a proper Dragon. Grind, polish, and shine!
Daya_Affinity1_3: I despise the term Dragon Lady, a more decorous form of address would be in order!
Daya_Affinity3: Whilst my constitution may be robust, it does not necessitate such a constant barrage! A modicum of restraint, if you please!
Daya_Affinity4: Sometimes I get tired too. Even sleeping is tiring.
Daya_Affinity5: The window isn't a diamond? Untrue!
Daya_Affinity6: Someday I'll be a jewel that shines brightly on her own in the sky!
Daya_Affinity7: What... dost thou expect a diamond ring or some such bauble from me?
Daya_Equipment: Proper equipment makes all the difference.
Daya_DeckSetting1: Stick with me, and you'll reach the top!
Daya_Touch1: Do not lay a hand on me so carelessly!
Daya_Touch1_1: Urgh, do you envy my perfection?
Daya_Touch2_1: Sometimes, things like this aren't so bad.
Daya_Touch1_2: I understand your feelings, but don't say it so often.
Daya_Touch2: Be careful not to cut yourself.
Daya_Touch2_2: Hehe, does it please your eye?
Daya_DutchRubEnd2: Wh-Why wouldst thou do such a thing?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Daya_Skin1: Daya never missed out on being the top student and student council president throughout her school years. It was during this time that many dragons began to secretly admire her.
Daya_Growth1_Skin1: The exam covers up to here. I have already finished reviewing it.
Daya_Growth2_Skin1: Must I serve as student council president again next year?
Daya_Equipment_Skin1: You packed today's supplies for me too? Thank you...
Daya_HeroSkill_Skin1: I no longer need fear the practical exam.
Daya_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Is graduation approaching? You will give me an answer before then, yes?
Daya_Board_Skin1: You want to visit the school store together? V-very well!
Daya_Touch1_1_Skin1: Mmm~ Shall I keep you after school?
Daya_Touch1_2_Skin1: Well, you only do this because we are close, correct?
Daya_Touch2_1_Skin1: This... is not something one can learn from studying.
Daya_Touch2_2_Skin1: V-very well. A little more, please.
Daya_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Cease this incessant striking of my head!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Daya_Skin2: Instead of joining the water games, Daya decides to serve as a safety officer. The problem is that she blows her whistle whenever anyone so much as puts a foot near the water.
Daya_Growth2_Skin2: I have mastered every safety regulation.
Daya_LevelUp_Skin2: The agent qualification exam? A perfect score, naturally!
Daya_Equipment_Skin2: Safety demands a great many tools.
Daya_HeroSkill_Skin2: Very well, leave the swimming to me.
Daya_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: I have become the safety officer in charge.
Daya_Board_Skin2: It is not dangerous, is it?
Daya_Touch1_Skin2: Ah! I am a safety officer! Attacks are forbidden!
Daya_Touch1_1_Skin2: Nnnngh~ You! Entering the water is forbidden!
Daya_Touch2_Skin2: D-do not think this will make me overlook anything.
Daya_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Thou darest to threaten the well-being of a safety officer?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Daya_Skin3: Daya learned from a close friend how to keep shining even in the darkness. Now her beauty never fades, no matter where she goes.
Daya_Growth1_Skin3: Darkness that holds light within it. That is what I am.
Daya_Growth2_Skin3: Whatever may happen, I shall never lose my light.
Daya_LevelUp_Skin3: I wish to become a light that illuminates the dark night.
Daya_Equipment_Skin3: Will you make it match? All black.
Daya_HeroSkill_Skin3: Black, the color that absorbs all light...
Daya_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: There is nothing wrong with growing once more.
Daya_Board_Skin3: Walk through this darkness with me.
Daya_Touch1_Skin3: Impossible! My hardness should be unchanged!
Daya_Touch1_1_Skin3: How cruel! You do not even know why you are doing this!
Daya_Touch1_2_Skin3: Hmph! I shall remain upset with thee!
Daya_Touch2_Skin3: Am I a little cold? It is not intentional...
Daya_Touch2_1_Skin3: Well... Being treated like a child is not so bad on occasion...
Daya_Touch2_2_Skin3: Sometimes I wish you would hold my hand instead of touching my head...
Daya_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: Keep this up and I shall bite thee! Ahn!
Aside_Get_Daya1:
A ring looking for its owner.
Who will this ring go to?
Aside_Upgrade_Daya1: Will you think of me when you see the ring? I hope this cheers you up.
Daya_AsideGet: A ring in search of its owner. I wonder to whom this ring will go?
Daya_AsideUpgrade: Will they think of me when they see the ring? I hope it gives them strength.
Daya_SkillCast: Shall we turn the tables with elegance?
Daya_Birthday: Accumulated years are the finest experience points.
Daya_Gacha2: The strongest of the dragons has arrived.
Daya_Gacha3: Nothing is tougher than a diamond!
Daya_Line3: It needs a little more sparkle.
Daya_Lobby: Nothing compares to standing in the light.
LoveLetter_Daya:
Master, thank you for always caring for me and treating me with consideration, whether in the banquet hall or at the Order.

You once happened to mention that you might someday return to your homeland. What would I do if that day truly came? I do not even want to imagine Elias without you.

If you decide to return home, please do not forget to take me with you. Even in another world, I believe I could be happy as long as I were with you...
LoveCall_Daya:
Master, this may be sudden, but I called because I have a favor to ask.

I am making something to give you as a gift.
But as I was preparing to finish it, I realized that I had forgotten one very important fact.
I... do not know the size of your finger.
I would like to visit and measure it. Are you free today?
If you are busy, I can come another day, so answer however is most convenient.

Hmm? What sort of gift requires your finger to be measured?
Hehe. I shall only say that it is a very special accessory set with a diamond.
I am making it with all my heart, so I hope you will accept it gladly.

Then, Master, I shall come to see you soon. Look forward to my gift.
Affinity_Daya_EP01_001: Hast thou ever regretted becoming the Master?
Affinity_Daya_EP01_003: Art thou in earnest...? The fate of Elias is bleak, with one such as thee serving Yggdrasil.
Affinity_Daya_EP01_004: Never. It always feels so great.
Affinity_Daya_EP01_005: Thou art fervent, art thou not? Yet take heed, lest thou grow complacent.
Affinity_Daya_EP01_006: I'd be lying if I said I didn't. I'm too busy nowadays.
Affinity_Daya_EP01_007:
Thou art honest. Be not too harsh on thyself, for such self-reflection doth render thee perfect.
I shall be here to aid thee as well.
Affinity_Daya_EP02_001: What dost thou consider when choosing a leader, Master?
Affinity_Daya_EP02_002: I am the Master. Hence, I am the leader. A self-elected leader is perfect!
Affinity_Daya_EP02_003:
A kingdom without the separation of church and state tends to be unsettled...
but I must admit that Sprite Kingdom doth appear to require thy aid.
Affinity_Daya_EP02_004: It doesn't matter who gets elected. They're all the same anyway.
Affinity_Daya_EP02_005:
Thou hast a rather unfavorable view of the electoral system.
Are the power struggles among those in authority indeed the answer?
Affinity_Daya_EP02_006: I would review the information on candidates and do a background check.
Affinity_Daya_EP02_007: A fine demeanor, indeed. I ought to work harder, if only for discerning folks like thee.
Affinity_Daya_EP03_001: What manner of gem be the stars that shine in the night sky? I would love to pick and collect them someday.
Affinity_Daya_EP03_002: Stars are planets that reflect light. They cannot be collected.
Affinity_Daya_EP03_003: Speakest thou as if thou hast ascended unto the very night sky itself! Yet thou canst not even fly.
Affinity_Daya_EP03_004: One day, I'll pick them from the sky myself and give them to you.
Affinity_Daya_EP03_005: I am grateful for thy words, but I must decline. 'Tis meaningless unless I do it myself.
Affinity_Daya_EP03_006: Maybe they are alien dragons that look like transparent gems...?
Affinity_Daya_EP03_007: Dost thou mean I shall encounter new kin? I wonder what they are like.
Affinity_Daya_EP04_001: Now that the dragons have begun to interact with Elias, what must I have them do next...? This doth fill me with concern.
Affinity_Daya_EP04_002: With your leadership, they'll be fine no matter what happens.
Affinity_Daya_EP04_003: Unwarranted praise doth make me feel rather uncomfortable.
Affinity_Daya_EP04_004: Getting familiar with other races would be great.
Affinity_Daya_EP04_005: Dost thou mean the understanding of others comes first? 'Twould be good if thou wouldst be a good bridge between us.
Affinity_Daya_EP04_006: Try to communicate with other races first. And if it fails, resort to force.
Affinity_Daya_EP04_007:
Doth the logic of power apply to other races as well?
Yet other leaders seem rather weak in this regard...?
Affinity_Daya_EP05_001: How fareth the Sprite Queen these days?
Affinity_Daya_EP05_002: Erpin is the same as always.
Affinity_Daya_EP05_003: Don't fret too much. Everyone grows up one day.
Affinity_Daya_EP05_004: I'm more curious about how you're doing over that rascal.
Affinity_Daya_EP05_005: Art thou worried about me? Dost thou doubt my ability to govern...?
Affinity_Daya_EP05_006: She's pathetic. You should tutor her on how to be a queen sometime.
Affinity_Daya_EP05_007: Dost thou want me to share my knowledge...? 'Tis an interesting idea. Very well, I shall.
Affinity_Daya_EP06_001: What dost thou think thy strengths and weaknesses are, Master?
Affinity_Daya_EP06_002: My strength lies in how patient and sociable I am.
Affinity_Daya_EP06_003: Indeed, given how thou art usually, I cannot disagree.
Affinity_Daya_EP06_005: Speak no lies, for no creature is without flaws. Perhaps that baseless confidence is thy weakness?
Affinity_Daya_EP06_006: Don't answer and try to change the subject.
Affinity_Daya_EP06_007: Well done. Sometimes it pays to keep thy strengths and weaknesses a secret.
Affinity_Daya_EP07_001: I humbly apologize regarding the last council of leaders. I was quite late, wasn't I? I was engrossed in the mirror...
Affinity_Daya_EP07_002: You are always late. Why are you so bad at being on time?
Affinity_Daya_EP07_003: I... cannot guarantee that I shall always be on time. Preparations to venture forth do take a considerable length of time.
Affinity_Daya_EP07_004: I suppose it can't be helped, since you care a lot about your looks.
Affinity_Daya_EP07_005: Thine outer visage is but as crucial as thine inner self. Neither can be deemed unworthy!
Affinity_Daya_EP07_006: It's okay. There's a certain someone who is also just as late...
Affinity_Daya_EP07_007: Wh-What?! Art thou implying I am equal to that rascal?!
Affinity_Daya_EP08_001:
What, pray tell, be the standards of perfection?
Must I conform to the world, or ought the world conform to me...?
Affinity_Daya_EP08_002: Won't the rest of the world follow your standards once you are perfect?
Affinity_Daya_EP08_003: How can I be perfect if I know not what it means to be perfect? What a conundrum this is.
Affinity_Daya_EP08_004: I think it's right to conform to the standards demanded by the world.
Affinity_Daya_EP08_005: Indeed, is that really the answer...? Are mine own thoughts and opinions ultimately worthless?
Affinity_Daya_EP08_006: You should set your own standards and stick to them.
Affinity_Daya_EP08_007: I see...! This kind of train of thought typically leads nowhere. I thank thee for thy sound advice.
Affinity_Daya_EP09_001: What sayest thou to adding diamonds to the banquet hall menu? 'Twould be a meal rich in minerals.
Affinity_Daya_EP09_002: I think that would only be enjoyed by a small minority...
Affinity_Daya_EP09_003: Thinkest thou so? Nevertheless, I believe 'tis a flavor worth trying.
Affinity_Daya_EP09_004: If we serve diamonds, there will be too many leftovers.
Affinity_Daya_EP09_005: Dost thou mean guests shall leave food uneaten? Hmm, how unseemly.
Affinity_Daya_EP09_006: If you could provide them for free, I'll think about it.
Affinity_Daya_EP09_007: Indeed, 'twould be good to run a trial. I happen to possess many flat and transparent things.
Affinity_Daya_EP10_001: The elves whispered to each other upon seeing me. Dost thou know why?
Affinity_Daya_EP10_002: They don't see dragons very often. They're probably marveling at you.
Affinity_Daya_EP10_003: Is that so? But openly pointing their fingers at me is rather offensive.
Affinity_Daya_EP10_004: If you see a cosmetics model on the street, how can you not be surprised?
Affinity_Daya_EP10_005: A model? Who? I do not understand what thou art saying.
Affinity_Daya_EP10_006: They must be admiring your sparkling, transparent beauty. What else?
Affinity_Daya_EP10_007: Thou speakest the obvious, but 'tis not unpleasant to hear, nonetheless. It hath pleased me.
Affinity_Daya_EP11_001: I heard the Elves possess a device that authenticates diamonds. I acquired one recently!
Affinity_Daya_EP11_002: You did not purchase it from Sist, did you?
Affinity_Daya_EP11_003: Sist did introduce me to the seller... How did you know? D-Do not tell me this is fake too?
Affinity_Daya_EP11_004: Congratulations. Now you will no longer be deceived, correct?
Affinity_Daya_EP11_005: I must test it upon the furniture at home immediately!
Affinity_Daya_EP11_006: Should you not begin by doubting anything made by the Elves?
Affinity_Daya_EP11_007: Beginning with suspicion is wrong, Master. One should offer trust first.
Affinity_Daya_EP12_001: If we competed against the other kingdoms, where would we Dragons rank?
Affinity_Daya_EP12_002: If the contest concerns eating, surrender. You cannot defeat the Sprite Kingdom.
Affinity_Daya_EP12_003: Ah... I understand your point. We must determine the fields in which we are competitive.
Affinity_Daya_EP12_004: Whatever the category, you would rank near the top.
Affinity_Daya_EP12_005: Would we? You hold us in high regard, Master.
Affinity_Daya_EP12_006: You do nothing but fight among yourselves, so perhaps not especially high.
Affinity_Daya_EP12_007: D-Duels are sacred! We attend to every basic duty before we fight!
Affinity_Daya_EP13_001: The Witches always seem wary of us. Can they not trust a neighboring people?
Affinity_Daya_EP13_002: Every Witch is different. Some must be friendly toward you.
Affinity_Daya_EP13_003: That is true. What a wise observation. I should not judge them all by a few.
Affinity_Daya_EP13_004: When stone-eaters constantly brawl, anyone would be wary.
Affinity_Daya_EP13_005: W-We do not eat just any stone! We possess preferences too!
Affinity_Daya_EP13_006: The closer the relationship, the more vigilant one should remain.
Affinity_Daya_EP13_007: Hmm... Like the relationship between Sprites and Elves? That gives me much to consider.
Affinity_Daya_EP14_001: I worry that Leets wandering the surface may inconvenience others.
Affinity_Daya_EP14_002: It is fine. Leets is well mannered.
Affinity_Daya_EP14_003: Is she? If you say so, Master, I am relieved.
Affinity_Daya_EP14_004: Leets does destroy things here and there.
Affinity_Daya_EP14_005: W-Where has she caused trouble? I am sorry. I will apologize.
Affinity_Daya_EP14_006: Are you not worrying too much? Simply watch her without concern.
Affinity_Daya_EP14_007: Yes. I should not interfere rashly. Leets has a path of her own.
Affinity_Daya_EP15_001: Many people in the Sprite Kingdom are interested in fashion. Speaking with them was entertaining.
Affinity_Daya_EP15_003: Ah, the Sprite who owns the tailor shop. She understood my tastes immediately!
Affinity_Daya_EP15_005: Hmm. She made many rather overwhelming proposals... but she did possess rules of her own.
Affinity_Daya_EP15_006: Fashion? That is boring. Do not waste your time.
Affinity_Daya_EP15_007: If one cannot manage one's outward appearance, will the inside not become disorderly as well?
Affinity_Daya_EP16_001: A horned Beastfolk saw me and composed a hymn of praise. It was somewhat embarrassing.
Affinity_Daya_EP16_002: Epica did? Let me have a look, too!
Affinity_Daya_EP16_003: Eh? No! I-I shall keep it to myself! 'Tis embarrassing!
Affinity_Daya_EP16_004: Yeah, Epica does that for just about everyone.
Affinity_Daya_EP16_005: What? Urgh... So she's just a bard who makes up whatever enters her mind? 'Tis mildly disappointing.
Affinity_Daya_EP16_006: I composed one for you as well. Wanna see?
Affinity_Daya_EP16_007: Hast thou truly had time to come up with such a thing, M-Master? I... I shall accept it if thou art offering.
Affinity_Daya_EP17_001: It seemeth Vivi hath great trouble fitting herself unto this modern world. How shall we aid her?
Affinity_Daya_EP17_002: I don't think we need to worry about Vivi though.
Affinity_Daya_EP17_003: Is that so? She shall manage well enough on her own. Hmm... Still, I do wish she might fashion a more well-rounded disposition.
Affinity_Daya_EP17_004: Let's raid her roost for an initiation ceremony.
Affinity_Daya_EP17_005: Master! Enter not another's room unbidden! Truly, thou art most impetuous!
Affinity_Daya_EP17_006: Aren't you teaching her well? That should be enough.
Affinity_Daya_EP17_007: I know not whether I do it alright, but I do my utmost...
Affinity_Daya_EP18_001: Of late, more dragons do seek to ascend unto the surface. Would they all forsake me?
Affinity_Daya_EP18_002: Don't blame yourself. Everyone has their own life to live.
Affinity_Daya_EP18_003: Grateful am I for thy solace... but yet doth disappointment linger in my heart.
Affinity_Daya_EP18_004: The dragon society is quite a stifling one.
Affinity_Daya_EP18_005: So it is, indeed? Must I change somewhat? Hast thou any good counsel, Master?
Affinity_Daya_EP18_006: Dragons are like frogs in a well. They need to get out more.
Affinity_Daya_EP18_007: But lo, they are already without! They may wander at will!
Affinity_Daya_EP19_001: Of late, I have sought a villa nigh unto the Order, but verily, the cost of land is exceeding high.
Affinity_Daya_EP19_002: Should I look for a spare room in the Order?
Affinity_Daya_EP19_003: Truly? Would that be well? We need not decide this instant, need we?
Affinity_Daya_EP19_004: If it's in the Sprite Kingdom... I can negotiate with Ner.
Affinity_Daya_EP19_005: Grateful am I, Master! Henceforth we may meet full oft!
Affinity_Daya_EP19_006: The best land belongs to the Order, so other's are just supposed to stay away?
Affinity_Daya_EP19_007: I shall strive not to prove a burden. Yet I had hoped for a touch of aid...
Affinity_Daya_EP20_001: This spot upon my back I cannot reach to polish... I prithee, Master, help me but for a moment?
Affinity_Daya_EP20_003: Oooh...! Yes! Just there! how delightful!
Affinity_Daya_EP20_004: Just rub your back against that wall.
Affinity_Daya_EP20_005: Would it not appear most strange?! I did behold an Old Werebeast doing likewise in the park!
Affinity_Daya_EP20_006: Want me to carve it with a hammer and chisel?
Affinity_Daya_EP20_007: I am somewhat nervous, yet I beseech thee, carve not away too much.
